narrative: Proposes a publishable conjecture that replaces the arbitrary tolerance in high-dimensional near-orthogonality with a principled one derived from the Farey sequence, yielding the formula V(d,n) ~ (n²/π²)^d. The chapter argues this expression unifies musical consonance, neural network superposition capacity, and Many Worlds branch distinguishability under a single geometric framework, a connection not previously made explicit in the literature.
